instruction: Determine the appropriate tool among ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD, then complete the task with it. Launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to perform a transient heat-transfer analysis of a rectangular solid block (Variant A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system with appropriate thermal units. Model Definition: Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a rectangle from (0, 0) to (60, 18) and extrude it by 12 mm to produce a block of size 60 mm x 18 mm x 12 mm. Material and Section: Define a material named Steel with density = 7.85e-9 tonne/mm^3, thermal conductivity = 0.045 W/(mm·K), and specific heat = 4.5e8 mJ/(tonne·K). Create a Homogeneous Solid Section using Steel and assign it to the entire block. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the block. Analysis Step: Create a Heat Transfer step named Step-Heat-A with transient response. Set the time period to 300 s, the initial increment to 2 s, the maximum increment to 15 s, and the maximum allowable temperature change per increment DELTMX to 10. Initial and Boundary Conditions: Apply an initial uniform temperature of 25 degC to the whole block. Apply a temperature boundary condition of 95 degC on the X = 0 face during Step-Heat-A. Discretization: Mesh the block with a global seed size of 4 mm. Assign DC3D8 heat-transfer brick elements and generate the mesh. Job Execution: Create a job named Job-TransientHeat-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully. Post-Processing: Review the temperature field at the final time. Record the average temperature near the X = 0 heated face, the average temperature in the X approximately 5 mm band, and the final analysis time. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
